entities.description: The user table is used to store new users, including id as primary key, username, password, date of birth, gender, and contact number.

entities.description: This table stores data of buyers and sellers who offer products, and information about offers received.

entities.name: ProductTable
entities.description: This table contains basic properties of products like product name, price, user email, and category, for registered users to view, buy, and sell.

entities.description: This table stores information of requests made by registered users and requests made to users by probable buyers, displayed on the user's profile page.

entities.name: ProductDetailTable
entities.description: This table contains detailed product information including name, company, price, condition, usage duration, home delivery, warranty period, warranty conditions, and extra keywords.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages user registration, authentication, and core user profile information. Ensures secure access to the platform.

actors.name: RegisteredUser
actors.description: A user who has successfully registered and logged into the platform, capable of logging in, searching for products, viewing product details, adding products, and viewing their profile.

actors.name: NonRegisteredUser
actors.description: A user who has not yet registered an account on the platform and can perform actions like registration.

capabilities.name: RegisterToWebsite
capabilities.description: The non-registered users can register into the website by entering first name, middle name, last name, gender, profile picture, contact number, birthdate, username, email, password and then verify email. If verification is successful then the page is redirected to the login page.

capabilities.name: LoginToWebsite
capabilities.description: Registered users can log in to the system using their credentials. If username or email and password match then, users are logged in to the platform otherwise, error message for invalid username and password is displayed.

capabilities.name: ViewProfile
capabilities.description: Display a registered user's personal profile information, including name, gender, username, email, contact number, birthdate, and profile picture.

capabilities.name: RegisterUser
capabilities.description: Allow non-registered users to create an account by providing personal details and verifying their email.

capabilities.name: LoginUser
capabilities.description: Allow registered users to access the platform by authenticating their username or email and password.

entities.name: Profile
entities.description: A collection of user's personal information including name, gender, username, email, contact number, birthdate, and profile picture.

entities.name: Email
entities.description: A digital message used for communication and authentication.

entities.name: Credential
entities.description: A user's username or email and password used for logging into the system.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages the listing, searching, and detailed viewing of products available on the platform.

capabilities.description: A search bar available in the platform can be used to search for the required product. Users can also search through the category of products. Users can input key words in the search bar and if the relevant match is found, then the title matching the word is displayed otherwise, ‘No products found’ message is displayed.

bounded_contexts.description: Facilitates the buying and selling of products between consumers, including adding products for sale, managing offers, and tracking requests.

capabilities.name: AddProduct
capabilities.description: Users can add product and its details with their information. They must specify product name, product category, picture of the product, owner name, and description of product, price details, product condition, warranty and home delivery details.

capabilities.name: ViewProductDashboard
capabilities.description: Users can view the number of products they have added to sell, requested to buy and been offered for the product they put on sale

capabilities.name: BuyProduct

capabilities.name: SellProduct
capabilities.description: Allow registered users to sell their product by adding it to their profile for public posting.
